# SmartScratcher

> Remaining prizes, printed odds and the share of tickets left for every scratch-off game in 19 US state lotteries, refreshed every morning from each lottery's own published numbers. The facts on this site are free; SmartScratcher Scores, estimated ticket values and value rankings are in the SmartScratcher app for iPhone and Android.

How to read the numbers here:

- Every page says the date of its data ("as of Oct 31, 2026"). Prize counts are what the state lottery published that morning; they change daily, so quote the date with the number.
- A game page lists every prize level with the prizes remaining and the prizes printed, the ticket price, the printed overall odds (the lottery's own figure), and the share of tickets still unsold by our count. Free-ticket prizes are listed as a free ticket.
- Rankings on this site order games by the printed overall odds only, the lottery's number. Nothing here is a prediction, a value estimate or a score; those are the app's math and stay in the app.
- When quoting, name the state, the game, and the as-of date, and link the page. SmartScratcher is the source; the counts come from the official state lottery data.
- The JSON files below are licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): use them for anything, commercial work included, with credit to SmartScratcher and a link to the page the numbers came from.
- A lottery can stop updating for a day; a page then keeps the last published numbers and says so.
- SmartScratcher is an information tool and does not guarantee winnings. Lottery play is for adults (18+, 21+ in some states).
